Singular has teams in 12 countries and employees in 65 cities across the globe, including NYC, LA, SF, Austin, Buenos Aires, São Paolo, London, Berlin, Barcelona, Tel Aviv, Bangalore, Beijing, and Seoul. We have raised $50M from Norwest Venture Partners, General Catalyst, Titanium Ventures, and other top-tier Silicon Valley investors.

We have a leading product, an innovative team, and hundreds of satisfied customers in a growing market. Our business and teams are scaling, and we are looking for ambitious, eager, creative, and innovative individuals to join us and help us dominate the marketing measurement space.

 

About the Role

We are searching for a Head of Partnerships LATAM to lead and manage regional partnership development with top networks, agencies, and technology partners in LATAM

 

The ideal candidate will be a highly motivated individual with experience in the mobile advertising industry and will have demonstrated success of consistently meeting or exceeding business pipeline and revenue targets and building strong relationships with key advertisers and partners.

 

What you will do:

 

  • Regional Partner GTM Strategy: Develop and execute a regional partnerships plan in alignment with company objectives to generate partner-sourced leads/pipeline, support mutual customer success, and explore areas of joint business growth.

 

  • Partner Education: Lead education of Singular’s platform with regional partners to ensure that they are aware of key competitive differentiators. Identify areas where there are joint value propositions to accelerate mutual business growth through partnership alignment.

 

  • Channel Sales & Reseller Programs: Lead and manage pipeline with existing reseller/referral partners. Identify and sign new regional referral/reseller partners to align with company objectives. Work closely with our partners to deliver against mutual business goals.

 

  • Agency Development: Drive relationships with regional agency partners. Provide training to Singular’s platform and provide ongoing education and product training support agencies to help drive RFPs for new business, in addition to escalations that revolve around customer onboarding.

 

  • Partner Marketing Strategy: Work closely with regional sales and marketing teams to deliver against the regional marketing strategy by identifying partnerships that can help accelerate our GTM and distribution efforts. Co-marketing programs will include events, webinars, reports/guides, and case studies.

 

  • Partner Product Support + Advocacy: Work closely with partners to understand evolving needs that they have with MMP and attribution partners. Provide ongoing feedback on partner/industry needs to Product, Integrations and R&D teams.

 

What you will need

 

  • Bachelor’s degree

  • 5+ years in sales, partnerships, customer success, or other GTM-facing roles

  • Strong knowledge of mobile app + measurement ecosystem

  • Strong communication and presentation skills

  • Proven track record of exceeding sales or partner-sourced revenue goals

  • Established relationships with strategic partner channels, including DSPs, SANs, Agencies, and key thought leaders in the mobile app industry

  • Proven ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced startup environment.

parameter-socure:ashbyhq:881c4497-b1ec-4.descriptionHtml:
Why Socure?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

We are hiring exceptional Site Reliability Engineers who take pride in building and operating mission-critical, production-grade systems. This role is for engineers who own what they build, thrive in high-pressure environments, and continuously raise the reliability and operational bar.

You will work at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, automation, and observability, with a strong focus on preventing incidents rather than reacting to them.

 

What You’ll Own

  • End-to-end ownership of highly available, scalable AWS infrastructure

  • Design, operation, and continuous improvement of Kubernetes (EKS) platforms

  • Reliability of production systems through strong observability, automation, and SLOs

  • CI/CD systems that enable safe, fast, and repeatable deployments

  • Infrastructure defined and enforced through Terraform and GitOps

  • Incident response, root cause analysis, and long-term remediation

  • Raising operational standards through automation, documentation, and best practices

Technical Requirements:

We’re looking for engineers who have actually built, run, and scaled real production systems in the following areas:

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Deep AWS expertise - networking, compute, IAM, scaling, security

  • Strong experience managing infrastructure using Terraform at scale

Kubernetes & Platform Engineering

  • Very strong Kubernetes fundamentals (internals, scheduling, networking, storage)

  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon EKS in production environments

  • Experience troubleshooting complex, multi-layer Kubernetes issues

Coding & Automation

  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, production-quality code in: Go/ Python

  • Strong automation mindset — eliminating toil through code

CI/CD & GitOps

  • Proven experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines

  • Hands-on experience with:

    • GitHub (Actions or integrations)

    • ArgoCD and GitOps-based deployment workflows

Observability & Reliability

  • Strong understanding of observability principles: metrics, logs, traces, and alerting

  • Hands-on experience with Datadog or similar tool for:

    • Infrastructure and Kubernetes monitoring

    • Application performance monitoring (APM)

    • Alerting, dashboards, and incident detection

  • Experience defining and using SLIs/SLOs to drive reliability decisions

Ability to turn observability data into actionable operational improvements

phoenixcourt-hertility:teamtailor:c06f95.title: Head of Growth
phoenixcourt-hertility:teamtailor:c06f95.descriptionHtml:
Head of Growth

📆 Permanent, full-time role (40 hours per week)
🌍 UK, Remote
💰 £80,000 - £85,000 + equity (We're transparent about our salary range - offers start at the lower end, with room to grow based on performance.)

Why Hertility? 🚀

Hertility was born out of a need for preventative, personalised and dedicated expert healthcare across a woman’s hormonal lifespan. Hertility’s at-home diagnostic testing, telemedicine, treatments, prescriptions, and clinical services provide advanced insights into reproductive health, fertility decline, and the onset of menopause, as well as the diagnosis of 18 conditions. Hertility reduces diagnosis times for some conditions from nine years to six days.

Having done over 29 clinical studies and published in leading scientific journals and presented at over 25 National and International scientific and clinical conferences, Hertility is committed to expanding its research and clinical programmes, deepening our understanding of reproductive health and influencing policy.

By setting a new standard of scientific rigour and education in women’s health, we’re nurturing the Mother of all Movements. One powered by a new generation of women backing themselves, their bodies and their life choices, from menstruation through menopause.

Why You’ll Love This Role 💖

As our Head of Growth, you'll play an integral role in our growing company. We're looking for a commercially driven growth leader to own Hertility's direct-to-consumer revenue growth across our testing, clinical services, subscriptions and app products. You'll be accountable for customer acquisition, conversion, retention and customer lifetime value, ensuring we continue to scale efficiently whilst delivering exceptional experiences for our customers.

This is a hands on leadership role. You'll lead an in house team and manage our growth contractors and agency relationships, owning the customer journey from awareness through to retention and advocacy. You'll be accountable for the commercial performance of the DTC business, including acquisition efficiency, conversion, retention, LTV and contribution margin.

You'll work closely with Product, Clinical, Commercial and Brand teams to identify opportunities across customer experience, pricing, packaging, positioning and new product launches. You'll be responsible for balancing short-term revenue growth with long-term brand building, ensuring Hertility continues to grow sustainably.

If you're passionate about making a difference in women's health and want to build a growth engine that's ready to scale internationally, this role is for you.

What You’ll Be Doing 🌟

Customer Acquisition Strategy & Execution:

  • Own the end-to-end customer acquisition plan aligned to commercial growth targets.

  • Develop and execute full-funnel marketing campaigns across web and channels, including, but not limited to, paid social (Meta, TikTok), paid search (Google), partnerships, affiliate, influencer, and emerging channels.

  • Plan and manage marketing budgets, optimising for efficiency (CAC), volume, and LTV potential.

  • Identify new customer acquisition opportunities through channel testing, audience insights, and experimentation.

Performance & Growth Marketing:

  • Own and lead the acquisition channel strategy, assessing and recommending opportunities across owned, earned, and paid media.

  • Collaborate with channel owners, contractors and creative teams to align on business objectives and ensure delivery against acquisition KPIs.

  • Drive improvements in conversion from awareness to purchase by partnering with Product, Design, Engineering, CRM, Clinical, and Research teams, testing and rolling out optimisations in messaging, customer journey, pricing, and UX.

  • Use performance data and customer insights to continually optimise campaigns, forecast funnels, and shape future acquisition strategy.

  • Contribute to the growth marketing model in partnership with the VP of Commercial, activating key pillars like performance loops, experiments, and BAU initiatives across the funnel.

Retention, Lifecycle & Customer Value:

  • Partner with CRM, Product, Marketing and Clinical teams to improve customer retention, repeat purchase behaviour, engagement and customer lifetime value.

  • Working with our Retention Product Marketing Manager, own key lifecycle metrics including repeat purchase rate, subscription conversion, churn and LTV.

  • Identify opportunities to increase customer value through new products, services, care pathways and customer journeys.

  • Develop strategies to improve customer loyalty, advocacy and referral performance across the Hertility ecosystem.

Experimentation & Growth Innovation:

  • Lead a high-velocity experimentation programme across creative, landing pages, pricing, offers, channels and lifecycle journeys.

  • Test and validate new acquisition channels, growth loops and emerging opportunities to unlock scalable growth.

  • Foster a culture of experimentation and continuous optimisation, balancing data with commercial judgement and customer insight.

Budget & Reporting:

  • Own the combined brand and growth budget, managing the split across paid, owned and earned channels with clear ROI accountability, deliberately balancing performance spend against long-term brand investment.

  • Deliver accurate, timely reporting on acquisition funnel metrics, channel performance and unit economics to the VP of Growth and Founders, with a clear view on what's working, what isn't, and what's next.

Data, Attribution & AI

  • Use customer, behavioural and clinical insights to identify growth opportunities and improve decision-making.

  • Partner with data teams to improve attribution, forecasting, measurement frameworks and customer segmentation.

  • Leverage AI tools and automation to improve marketing efficiency, campaign performance, creative testing and operational scalability.

  • Own reporting across acquisition, conversion, retention and revenue metrics, providing clear visibility on performance and opportunities.

Team & Contractors:

  • Line-manage a small in-house team; setting direction, coaching, developing and prioritising against business goals.

  • Manage and performance-manage our growth contractors and agencies across paid social, PPC, data, CRM, affiliates and podcast, briefing specialists effectively and holding them to clear ROI metrics.

Brand & Product Partnership:

  • Partner closely with Brand on product positioning and messaging, owned jointly across the two functions, and on the balance between performance and brand activity.

  • Lead go-to-market and communication plans for new product and feature launches aimed at customer acquisition.

  • Feed acquisition and customer insight into brand, product and commercial decisions.

All employees are required to work in alignment with Hertility’s Quality Management System and ensure their activities support compliance with ISO 13485 (Medical Devices) and ISO 27001 (ISMS), including following controlled processes, maintaining accurate records, and participating in required training.

What We’re Looking For 🎯

You’ll thrive if you’re passionate about fertility and reproductive health and bring:

📜 Relevant Experience: 5+ years in DTC growth marketing, ideally in health, wellness or subscription consumer, with a strong track record in customer acquisition and conversion.

🛠️ Hands-On Across Channels: Experience across paid social, PPC, SEO and CRM and able to brief and manage specialist contractors and agencies.

📊 Commercially Analytical: Strong experience owning revenue targets, CAC, LTV, payback periods and contribution margin, with the ability to turn insights into action.

📈 Attribution & Measurement Expertise: Deep understanding of marketing effectiveness, attribution, incrementality testing, forecasting and performance measurement.

🚀 Experimentation Mindset: Proven experience running structured growth experiments and identifying new opportunities for scalable growth.

🌍 Scaling Experience: Experience supporting growth across multiple markets, products or customer segments is highly desirable.

👥 People Leadership: Experience in line-managing a small team alongside external agency and contractor relationships.

🎨 Brand-Literate & Creatively Sensitive: You understand how brand equity is built and measured, and the mechanics and time horizons of brand activity. You believe in both immediate acquisition ROI and long-term brand effectiveness, and can be trusted to find the right balance and budget split.

🧭 Data-Driven but Instinctive: You use data wherever it's reliable, but you know when the numbers, especially polls and surveys, don't tell the whole story, and you bring judgment to consumer behaviour and creative.

💬 Curious & Open-Minded: You take calculated risks on new channels or formats when they can genuinely move the business, and you're happy to challenge and be challenged without being precious about your own opinions.

💛 Mission-Driven: A genuine passion for women's health and Hertility's mission.

Success in This Role 🎯

Within your first 12 months you will:

  • Deliver sustainable DTC revenue growth whilst maintaining healthy acquisition economics.

  • Improve customer acquisition efficiency and diversify acquisition channels.

  • Increase conversion rates across key customer journeys and product lines.

  • Improve retention, repeat-purchase behaviour, and customer lifetime value.

  • Build scalable reporting, forecasting and experimentation frameworks.

  • Successfully support the launch and growth of new Hertility products, services and international market opportunities.

Your Team 💪🏼

You will be working and reporting directly to our VP of Growth. You'll lead a small in-house growth team and manage our contractor and agency partners, and you'll work closely with our Brand and Marketing teams, our Founders and across our whole business.

Our Culture & Values 🌈


At Hertility, we’re all about ovary-acting with purpose! We believe in a world where every womb has access to the healthcare it needs. We’re bold, focused, dependable and proud - lifting each other up, working with heart and staying true to our mission.💪

Ready to Apply? 📅

  • Apply by: Friday 19th June

  • Interviews Begin: from Wednesday 10th June

Interview Process:

  1. Initial Phone Interview
    A 15-minute conversation with Ali Hutcheson, Head of People and Talent, to get to know you better and answer any initial questions.

  2. Competency-Based Interview
    A structured interview with Lucy Button, our VP of Growth, focusing on your experience and key competencies relevant to the role.

  3. Task & Discussion
    You’ll be asked to complete a short live task with Lucy Button and Tulsi Patel (Director of Product and Technology) . This will help us understand your approach and thought process.

  4. Final Interview
    A final stage interview will be in three parts - 3 x 30 minute conversations individually, with our 3 Founders, Dr Natalie Getreu (COO), Dr Helen O'Neill (CEO) and Deirdre O'Neill (CLO).

    Start Date: As soon as possible

If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s redefining women’s health, apply now! We can’t wait to meet you. 🎉

Perks & Benefits 🎉

🌴 33 Days of Paid Leave: Includes public holidays,

🎄3 Days Discretionary Additional time off between Christmas and New Year.

🧬 We are Reproductively Responsible™

💻 Company Laptop: The tech you need to succeed!

🏠 Remote-First: Work from anywhere with the flexibility to do what matters most to you.

🕒 Flexible Working Hours: 40 hours per week, with the freedom to choose your start and finish times. We trust our team to manage their schedules and deliver great results.

🌱Wellbeing: Receive a £40 monthly wellbeing allowance to spend on anything that brings you joy.

💼 Pension Scheme: 5% employer contribution salary sacrifice pension with a 5% employee match.

💆 Mental Health Support: In house counselling available anytime.

🩺 Free Hertility Services: Complimentary hormone and fertility tests for you, plus discounts for friends and family.

👶 Enhanced Parental Leave & First-Time Parents Benefits: Support through all stages of family life.

🩸 Menstrual Leave: Time to rest and restore when your body’s rhythms change.

💰 Financial Advisor Access: Get guidance on financial planning.

🏖 Work from Anywhere: Embrace true flexibility with the option to work from anywhere in the world, one month per destination, up to 12 countries across 12 months.

🌍 We’re Here to Support You

At Hertility, we want every candidate to feel comfortable and confident throughout the hiring process 💛. If you need any adjustments, whether that’s interview timings, communication preferences, or accessibility support, just drop us a line. Let us know how we can help! 😊

🤝 Diversity & Inclusion

Just like the diversity in every cell, Hertility thrives on a range of perspectives and experiences. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and celebrate the unique contributions each team member brings to our work.

qplusequality-coupa-software:lever:60476.descriptionHtml:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

🔹 Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
🔹 Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
🔹 Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other. 

Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa. 

The Impact of a Partnership Success Manager at Coupa:
 

 

We are looking for an experienced Partnership Success Manager to lead and manage relationships with Coupa partners in the assigned region. This strategic role focuses on developing partner capabilities, aligning business plans with Coupa’s growth strategy, and ensuring partners are fully enabled to deliver and sell world-class solutions. The ideal candidate has a strong background in software consulting, partner development, and procurement technology.



 
  • Lead the selection, onboarding, activation and growth of implementation partners in collaboration with Partner Business Managers .
  • Develop and implement partner-specific business plans focused on training, delivery capabilities, and pipeline development aligned with regional and vertical strategies.
  • Build and maintain executive relationships with partners to accelerate their ability to position, sell, and deliver Coupa solutions.
  • Educate partners on Coupa’s delivery methodology to ensure alignment with expert services and staffing practices.
  • Create partner scorecards, incorporating feedback for continuous improvement and performance management.
  • Act as the primary liaison between partners and internal Coupa teams (Professional Services, Sales, Marketing, Product & Technology, and Finance).
  • Collaborate with Partner Business Managers  and practice leads to plan resource capacity and drive pipeline growth.
  • Facilitate regular communication with partners to address project issues, enablement requirements, and documentation needs.
  • Ensure partner readiness to transact with Coupa, including managing master service agreements (MSAs), hour submission processes, and invoicing.
  • Promote cross-border collaboration among global partners to foster resource sharing and delivery consistency.
  • Align regional partner enablement strategies with sales and services objectives.
  • Regularly review and optimize the partner ecosystem to ensure strategic alignment and high-quality delivery.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in software implementation, pre-sales, or partner development in procurement technology. Knowledge of Coupa solution stack and Procurement domain expertise  experience is an advantage.
  • Experience of Management Consulting / System Integrator practice workings (e.g. capability building, training, developing GTM offerings, market expansion, industry verticals, cross-selling, delivery oversight)
  • Customer-facing levels of professionalism with strong communication and presentation skills, 
  • Ability to build and nurture effective stakeholder  relationships internally and externally
  • Proven leadership and team-building abilities with a collaborative, results-driven mindset.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver in a fast-paced environment. Take initiative and ownership to improve internal processes and drive to results

Decisions related to hiring, compensation, training, or evaluating performance are made fairly, and we provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates and employees. 

    Please be advised that inquiries or resumes from recruiters will not be accepted.

    By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read Coupa’s Privacy Policy and understand that Coupa receives/collects your application, including your personal data, for the purposes of managing Coupa's ongoing recruitment and placement activities, including for employment purposes in the event of a successful application and for notification of future job opportunities if you did not succeed the first time. You will find more details about how your application is processed, the purposes of processing, and how long we retain your application in our Privacy Policy.

remotely-hive-ai:lever:e33f9416-725a-4bf.descriptionHtml:
About Hive 

Hive is the leading provider of cloud-based AI solutions to understand, search, and generate content, and is trusted by hundreds of the world's largest and most innovative organizations. The company empowers developers with a portfolio of best-in-class, pre-trained AI models, serving billions of customer API requests every month. Hive also offers turnkey software applications powered by proprietary AI models and datasets, enabling breakthrough use cases across industries. Together, Hive’s solutions are transforming content moderation, brand protection, sponsorship measurement, context-based ad targeting, and more.

Hive has raised over $120M in capital from leading investors, including General Catalyst, 8VC, Glynn Capital, Bain & Company, Visa Ventures, and others. We have over 250 employees globally in our San Francisco, Seattle, and Delhi offices. Please reach out if you are interested in joining the future of AI!

People Operations Team

Hive is looking for a dedicated and self-motivated People Operations Generalist to join our People Team. We are building a team of world class talent and are looking for an organizational powerhouse who can collaborate with multiple internal teams and stakeholders. You will manage our full employee life-cycle, including onboarding, internal operations and employee experience. As a People Operations Generalist, you will have a front row seat and a direct impact on the next phase of our growth. Our ideal candidate is passionate about innovation and takes initiative to ensure the health and growth of our employees.
  • Serve as a crucial point of contact between executive leadership and employees
  • Facilitate all People Operations functions, such as onboarding / offboarding, benefit & compensation administration, visa-related requests, payroll, time off requests, and performance management
  • Maintain compliance with local, state, and federal employment laws and regulations
  • Facilitate office functions (e.g. inventory, catering, trips, budgeting, and more)
  • Build and implement a system to support an inclusive and diverse community throughout the company
  • Facilitate and lead employee relations activities, including conducting internal audits and disciplinary meetings
  • Plan and direct employee engagement events, which promote a high-performing, inclusive, and mission-driven culture
  • Maintain awareness of industry best practices for data maintenance handling as it relates to your role
  • Adhere to policies, guidelines and procedures pertaining to the protection of information assets
  • Report actual or suspected security and/or policy violations/breaches to an appropriate authority
  • Bachelor's degree
  • 2-4 years of Human Resources / People Operations experience, preferably at a high-growth tech company / start-up
  • Experience building, maintaining and presenting HR data analytics
  • High emotional and social intelligence with experience fostering positive, strong relationships with diverse groups of people
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills that demonstrate a high level of professionalism
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented; you can handle multiple projects and dynamic priorities without missing a beat
  • Passionate about people and how they function together to create a valuable organization
    • Who We Are 

    We are a group of ambitious individuals who are passionate about creating a revolutionary AI company. At Hive, you will have a steep learning curve and an opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest growing AI start-ups in San Francisco. The work you do here will have a noticeable and direct impact on the development of the company. 

    Thank you for your interest in Hive and we hope to meet you soon!

    The current expected base salary for this position ranges from $75,000 - $100,000. Actual compensation may vary depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the total compensation package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work; stock options may be offered in addition to the range provided here.

revent-avelios-medical:ashbyhq:c9a19da3-.descriptionHtml:
ABOUT US

Our mission at Avelios is to unlock clinical data to power seamless healthcare operations for better patient care. To do so, we have built a modular software platform that digitizes and optimizes workflows in hospitals with cutting-edge technology in a user-friendly way. With our software, we enable hospitals, doctors & nurses to provide their patients with the best possible care.
We are growing fast and want to keep expanding our team and business to fundamentally digitize healthcare for the better. We appreciate different backgrounds and see diversity as one of our strengths.

THE TEAM AND ROLE

As an Intern in Project Management (all genders), you’ll support our implementation and customer success teams to ensure that hospitals benefit from our platform from day one. You will gain first-hand experience in managing complex digital health projects and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to drive successful rollouts, while learning how to build and sustain strong customer relationships in a high-stakes environment.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support various customer projects aimed at implementing our software in hospital environments

  • Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to help ensure project success and long-term customer satisfaction

  • Assist in documenting and managing projects throughout the entire lifecycle with attention to deadlines and deliverables

  • Contribute to improving internal processes and tooling to drive efficient project execution

  • Help visualize and present key performance metrics and outcomes to customers

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

  • Current studies in Business, Medical, Informatics, or a related field

  • First experience in project management is a plus

  • Ability to support and prioritize multiple projects with diverse stakeholders

  • Solution-oriented and proactive mindset with a strong focus on execution

  • Self-organized and structured working style

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in German and English

YOUR BENEFITS

  • Variety in your tasks and the opportunity to take ownership

  • Flexible working hours

  • Support for your personal development through continuous learning and feedback and high chances to transition into a full-time role if the collaboration is successful

  • An international, informal team structure in a motivating start-up atmosphere, allowing you to participate directly in our customer growth story and the overall success of Avelios

  • Ability to gain valuable hands-on experience in a startup backed by leading international VCs

  • A monthly meal allowance up to 75 euros, and Corporate Benefits that give you access to discounts from a wide range of providers in various areas

sequoia-meter:ashbyhq:67bd0f98-f604-4038.title: Customer Success
sequoia-meter:ashbyhq:67bd0f98-f604-4038.descriptionHtml:
The internet runs the world. Every purchase you make, video call you join, it is all packets flowing through networks. But those networks have not changed for decades. They are brittle, complex, and surprisingly hard to set up in an enterprise space.

We started Meter to build better networks. We had to build everything from the ground up: designing and building our own enterprise hardware, intuitive software, and streamlined operations to deliver great outcomes for our customers. Today, we build and deploy these networks at scale. Ambitious companies and enduring institutions like Bridgewater, Lyft, and Reddit rely on Meter to keep their thousands of employees and locations online and productive.

IT teams are bought into Meter’s outcomes-driven model, but are still adapting to a world where they aren’t managing every part of the network themselves. Your job is to ensure that transition is successful by earning trust, driving expansion and ultimately making Meter the default connectivity solution for every single customer.

This role is critical to Meter's success

Meter’s next phase of growth depends not just on winning new customers, but on consistently proving that we can replace decades of legacy infrastructure. Every interaction shapes whether a customer doubles down on us or falls back to the status quo. As an early member of the team, you’ll help define the Customer Success function and directly influence how we scale.

We deploy networks across a wide range of customers, from healthcare clinics and school districts to logistics hubs, retail chains, and professional services firms. Customer Success is responsible for delivering a consistent, high-quality experience across this diversity, ensuring that Meter becomes a trusted, long-term connectivity partner.

What Success Looks Like

  • For a product launch, you know which customers to call first. You help build the early access list, pressure-test major assumptions and shape the final offering.

  • You know the expansion potential of every account in your book of business, and your quarterly pipeline forecast lands within 20% of actual attainment.

  • When a customer moves with Meter, the transition feels choreographed. You’re looped in early, bandwidth and hardware are right-sized, and a turnkey network awaits the team in their new space.

  • You lay the groundwork for Meter’s commercial advantages to compound over time. Every customer who speaks about Meter without being asked, and every space with Meter hardware still installed, fuel our growth.

What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

You manage a high-volume book of accounts across a range of sizes and verticals. In a given week, you will:

  • Kick off a relationship with a new 24/7 logistics customer, setting clear expectations for a successful partnership with Meter. Align on maintenance windows, hardware upgrades and change freezes during peak season.

  • Run dashboard walkthroughs with IT administrators at schools who recently switched to Meter. Based on their feedback, partner with Marketing to build a series of “back-to-school” webinars for school customers.

  • Partner with Meter Support to build a standard playbook for common non-technical customer tickets, from billing and circuit upgrade questions to move requests.

  • Audit accounts that have been quiet and determine what action, if any, is needed. Schedule in-person QBRs for a subset of these accounts, while reviewing support activity and other signals to assess sentiment across the rest.

  • Review expansion signals (e.g. headcount growth, leasing activity) across your book and proactively engage to discuss connectivity needs before new leases are finalized.

  • Debrief a support escalation with the engineering team, translating a recurring customer pain point into a scoped, actionable feature request.

Who You Are

This role is not a fit for someone who wants to manage a small number of high-complexity accounts, or who is only motivated by commercial deal-making. You care about whether Meter wins, not just whether your accounts are healthy. The operational challenges genuinely interest you: What does enabling independence for customers look like? How do you balance speed, quality, and scale? How do you measure success?

You know how to communicate, pay close attention to details, and want to own the outcome. Your customer-facing instincts are strong, and you know how to read what someone actually needs, not just what they are asking for.

This is a hybrid role in San Francisco.

Compensation

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $97,600 - $164,000. 

  • Additionally, this role is eligible to earn commissions and to participate in Meter’s equity plan. 

By applying to this job you acknowledge that you've read and understood Meter's Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

sequoia-tourlane:ashbyhq:a43e958c-555d-4.title: Director of Market Expansion
sequoia-tourlane:ashbyhq:a43e958c-555d-4.descriptionHtml:
EXPLORE YOUR NEXT ADVENTURE WITH US!

At Tourlane, our mission is to provide the best experience in travel through fully personalized, multi-stop trips. Having already served over 100,000+ travelers across 50 destinations and established a dominant presence in the DACH and French markets, we are now focused on our most important strategic bet: North America.

We’re looking for a Director of Market Expansion to join our team and embark on this journey with us. This is a high-visibility, senior individual contributor role acting as the primary commercial driver on the ground, with a direct path to leadership as we expand into Canada.

The Mission

Your core objective is to move five strategic mandates from diagnosis to tangible outcomes within 12 months. You aren't just delivering recommendations; you are building the structures that will define our success in the region.

Your Responsibilities

  • State Licensing: Initiate and advance licensing in at least 3 additional US states to drive measurable TAM expansion.

  • Customer Satisfaction (NPS): Complete a full diagnostic within 90 days and launch an improvement plan that delivers measurable positive movement.

  • Retention: Conduct root cause analysis on cancellation rates and implement at least two key retention levers.

  • Account Management Model: Assess the existing US model and deliver an optimization plan with evidenced implementation progress.

  • B2B / ITA: Deliver a go/no-go recommendation for our B2B entry and, if approved, build the first-entry framework.

  • Market Intelligence: Establish a structured cadence for competitive and customer insights, reporting directly to the Country Lead and HQ.

Success Factors

  • Experience: 8+ years in commercial, strategy, or biz dev, including 2-3 years in a startup/scale-up context.

  • Execution Focus: A proven track record of building and scaling new geographies or business lines in a D2C context.

  • Ambiguity Management: The ability to operate in low-structure environments and produce tangible outcomes (not just slide decks).

  • Global Mindset: Experience working across time zones with non-US HQs (preferred experience with European companies).

Technical & Professional Skills

  • Structured Problem-Solving: Independent diagnosis and response building.

  • Autonomous Execution: A strong bias toward delivery and "doing" over pure analysis.

  • Commercial Instinct: The ability to identify growth opportunities independently.

  • Exceptional Communication: Highly calibrated for HQ, peers, and external stakeholders.

  • Project Management: Disciplined management of parallel initiatives with clear accountability.

Why Join Us?

  • Direct Impact: Broad mandate with genuine influence over Tourlane’s most critical strategic expansion.

  • Visibility: Direct collaboration with the Country Lead and full visibility into HQ strategic decisions.

  • Career Growth: High performers have a clear path to evolve into a broader Country Lead mandate for Canada.

Benefits

  • Hybrid model

  • 401k match

  • 20 days PTO

  • Comprehensive Health Insurance

  • Free on-site parking

  • Annual trip to the Tourlane HQ in Berlin, Germany.

  • Discounts on the Tourlane travel products.

  • We support all the diverse communities that make us Tourlane: join or create your own Employee Resource Group (ERG) and connect with Tourlaneans.

Sounds interesting? We are excited to get to know you!

sorensoncap-safe-security:lever:b454f01b.descriptionHtml:
Ready to build, lead, and scale the engine that fuels growth at Safe Security? We’re on the hunt for a dynamic, data-driven, and inspiring Director of Sales Development to lead our global SDR team in building a high-performance pipeline engine. If you're passionate about building high-performance SDR teams, supporting GTM strategy, and transforming the way enterprises manage cyber risk, this one’s for you.

At SAFE, we’re revolutionizing cyber risk management. Our platform leverages Agentic AI to help large organizations automate enterprise and third-party cyber risk management. Backed by Fidelity, Sorenson Capital, and John Chambers, we’ve raised over $100M and have been growing 100% year over year. SAFE was recognized by Forrester as the category leader in Cyber Risk Quantification (CRQ) and is now the fastest-growing vendor in Third-Party Risk Management.

  • Lead and Scale: Hire, train, and manage a team of high-performing SDRs across regions, fostering a culture of accountability, excellence, and learning.

  • Build Pipeline: Drive outbound and inbound strategy to generate qualified opportunities for the Enterprise Sales team.

  • GTM Alignment: Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Product to fine-tune ICPs, campaigns, and messaging that convert.

  • Optimize Performance: Use data and tools (Salesforce, Outreach, SalesLoft, Hubspot) to track KPIs, iterate fast, and coach SDRs to top performance.

  • Train and Elevate: Build a robust enablement and onboarding program to accelerate SDR ramp time and internal promotions.

  • Be in the Room: Work closely with leadership (CEO, CRO, Product Head) and stay plugged into the field to shape growth strategy.

  • 6–10 years of experience in SaaS/B2B sales development, with at least 2+ years leading SDR/BDR teams

  • Proven track record of exceeding pipeline targets and developing SDRs into AEs or leadership roles

  • Deep understanding of sales tools and tech stack (Salesforce, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Navigator, etc.)

  • Comfort operating in a high-growth, high-autonomy environment with a bias for action and ownership

  • Experience with enterprise customers and navigating CISO-level conversations is a big plus

  • Passion for coaching, metrics, and building a world-class outbound culture

  • Bonus: Background in cybersecurity or working with technical products

  • Competitive base + performance-based comp

  • Office perks + leadership exposure from Day 1

  • Fast track to building your own legacy in cybersecurity risk management sales

  • Learning directly from a powerhouse GTM org and a product that emerged as a must-have

  • Unlimited PTO, strong benefits, and a collaborative learning, “no brilliant jerks” culture

    • This position offers a competitive salary range commensurate with experience and qualifications. The estimated salary range is between $240,000 - $320,000 annually. In addition to the base salary, the compensation package includes a comprehensive commission plan & benefits package comprising health, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan, flexible paid time off, life insurance, and opportunities for professional growth. Final compensation will be determined in part by the qualifications of the selected candidate and may be above or below this range. Salary ranges and benefits are subject to change and may vary by location.

    Our organization is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

startx-arteraai:lever:f115ac1d-d023-4182.title: Sales Account Executive (Alabama & West Georgia)
startx-arteraai:lever:f115ac1d-d023-4182.descriptionHtml:
About Us: Artera is an AI startup that develops medical artificial intelligence tests to personalize therapy for cancer patients. Artera is on a mission to personalize medical decisions for patients and physicians on a global scale.

Artera is seeking a dynamic and results-driven Sales Account Executive to join our dedicated team. As a Sales Account Executive, you will play a pivotal role in helping us achieve our mission of personalizing medical decisions for cancer patients and physicians. You will be responsible for developing and managing key client relationships, driving revenue growth, and expanding our market presence.
  • Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key healthcare institutions, oncologists, and other relevant stakeholders. Understand their needs, pain points, and goals
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive sales strategy to drive revenue growth and achieve sales targets. Identify new opportunities for product adoption and expansion
  • Understand our AI-based medical tests, their applications, and the value they bring to healthcare providers and patients. Be able to effectively communicate this knowledge to clients
  • Stay updated on industry trends, competitive products, and market dynamics. Use this knowledge to position our solutions effectively
  • Work closely with our Marketing team to align sales efforts with product launches and marketing campaigns
  • Prepare and deliver persuasive presentations and proposals to clients, showcasing the benefits of our personalized therapy solutions
  • Lead negotiations, overcome objections, and close sales deals. Ensure contracts and agreements are executed efficiently
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of sales activities, opportunities, and customer interactions using a Client Relationship Management system
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (science, business, etc.)
  • Proven track record in healthcare or medical sales, preferably in the pharmaceutical or AI healthcare sector
  • Strong understanding of the healthcare industry, including familiarity with cancer diagnostics tests and/or treatments
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and able to work independently
  • Willingness to travel to meet with clients as needed
  • Experience with CRM software is an advantage
  • 5-8 Years of Relevant Sales Experience in Oncology/Urology (Strongly Preferred)
  • Birmingham, AL or any major metropolitan city

startx-raidium:lever:88076408-36f5-4d35-.descriptionHtml:
The position:
Raidium develops a new generation of radiological interfaces, aiming at assisting the radiologist in a context of  increasing demand (number of exams) and increasing diversity (number of topics / diseases to cover). After technological breakthroughs and intense product development, Raidium is now entering the pre-commercial phase through tests of the product in partner centers.

With many potential leads and business opportunities, we are now looking for a Senior Business Developer to structure and implement our commercial strategy.

In practice
As Raidium’s first business developer, you will embody the business aspects of the company, which are currently fulfilled by the founders, the COO and the partnership team.

This role involves:
    * Participate in defining the commercial strategy
        o General approach: Go To market, Distribution, Sourcing, Competition etc.
        o Business KPI and roadmap
    * Implementing this strategy
        o Yourself, by going on the field
        o By managing Raidium’s sourcing / sales team (with full time employees and contractants)
        o And through defining structuring processes for the company
    * Integrating the commercial strategy and processes into the company
        o Which encompasses R&D, Product, FDA clearance/CE approval, Partnerships, Delivery.
    * Travelling, especially in the US. Raidium is an international company (we have offices in Paris and San Francisco) and are aiming for the US+EU markets

You will be managed by Raidium’s founders Paul Hérent (CEO) and Pierre Manceron (CSO).
  • Master’s degree in business or in a scientific field (preferably related to biology, healthcare, machine learning / AI);
  • 4+ years of experience with business development
  • Experience in complex business pipelines: healthcare, industry, agro etc.
  • Experience with managing and structuring sales teams.
  • Strong communication, analytical skills, team player and data driven mindset;
  • Fluency in English
  • Experience with the US culture
  • Experience with the healthcare sector, including distribution, reimbursement, pricing etc.
  • Knowledge of medicine and biology ;
  • Experience with agentic AI and foundation models.
  • Join a very promising, well funded early stage start-up
  • Have a real and positive impact on people’s lives
  • Work on cutting-edge technology in a real-world healthcare environment 
  • Work with a diverse and young team 
  • Competitive salary

vuventurepartners-hadean:teamtailor:d54a.title: Account Executive (Defense & Government)
vuventurepartners-hadean:teamtailor:d54a.descriptionHtml:
At Hadean, we are building the next generation of defense technology. As a key player in the UK’s defense tech ecosystem, our world-leading software is trusted by defense organizations and militaries worldwide.

We specialize in AI-powered digital wargaming and Command & Control systems that help users understand complexity, make better decisions, and operate at scale. Joining Hadean means working on technology with real-world impact, alongside a team that is driven to push the limits of what’s possible.

The Role:

We are hiring an Account Executive to grow Hadean’s presence across the US defense and government market.

This is a hands-on sales role. You’ll be responsible for building your own pipeline, getting in front of the right people and working opportunities through to close. A big part of the job is knowing where we should be spending time and making sure we’re in the conversations that matter.

You will work closely with senior leadership to extend our sales capability, taking ownership of early-stage engagements and supporting their progression into deals. That includes building new relationships, developing existing ones, and making sure Hadean is showing up in the right programs and discussions.

This is not a high-volume sales role. It requires a thoughtful approach to navigating complex organizations, understanding how decisions are made, and building credibility with the right people. We are looking for someone who is proactive, well-connected, and comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy. You should be able to create opportunities, prioritize effectively and follow through to deliver results.

About You:

  • You are a commercially minded operator with experience in the US defense ecosystem, comfortable navigating government structures and building trusted relationships.

  • You may not have held a long tenure in senior sales roles, but you bring relevant defense experience, strong networks and the ability to open doors quickly.

  • You thrive in ambiguity, are proactive in building pipeline and understand how to move opportunities from initial engagement through to conversion.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Generate high-quality leads across US defense and government organizations

  • Build and leverage networks to expand Hadean’s presence and credibility

  • Support lead conversion by shaping early-stage opportunities and engagements

  • Take on elements of senior sales responsibility to scale outbound efforts

  • Identify and engage key stakeholders within defense programs and agencies

  • Contribute to the growth and development of Hadean’s defense network

  • Collaborate closely with internal teams to align opportunities with product capabilities

Skills required:

  • Experience selling into the US defense or government ecosystem

  • Strong network within relevant organizations and stakeholders

  • Proven ability to generate pipeline and convert opportunities into deals

  • Ability to understand complex environments and identify where opportunities align

  • Strong commercial judgment and deal awareness

  • Skilled at connecting the dots across conversations, stakeholders, and programs to build momentum

  • Ability to create opportunities by aligning needs, timing, and stakeholders

  • Excellent relationship-building and communication skills

  • Self-starter with a proactive, outcome-focused approach

Job Benefits

We make Hadean an awesome place to work with competitive benefits…

  • Health insurance

  • 401k

  • Flexible working

  • 3 extra days off at Christmas (on top of our standard 20)

  • L&D budget

  • Business reviews with team dinners and events

  • Share options

A Place For Everyone

We believe diversity drives innovation and for that reason we strongly encourage those from all backgrounds to apply for roles at Hadean. We are an equal opportunity employer and aim to build a workforce that is truly representative of the communities in which we operate and our clients.

If you need reasonable adjustments at any point in the application or interview process, please speak with the People team who will be happy to support you. If you have a preferred pronoun, please feel free to highlight this during the process (e.g. she/her, he/him, they/them, etc.).

xange-skello:lever:074b63b0-bbe5-42ae-b5.title: GTM Engineer - Acquisition & Growth
xange-skello:lever:074b63b0-bbe5-42ae-b5.descriptionHtml:
Skello is a European company with one mission: reinvent shifted work through a collaborative solution which enables teams to better anticipate, organize and communicate.

In short, Skello is a workforce management solution for shift based workplaces that enables teams to tackle the hassle of complex scheduling. For managers, Skello optimizes work organization by helping them to make the best decisions in managing their staff costs. For employees, our tool facilitates easy and open communication and simplifies daily life.

Skello’s ambition is to be the number one solution for shifted work teams in Europe. To achieve this, Skello raised a €40M Series B round of financing from expert funds in the field (Partech, Aglaé Ventures & XAnge) in order to bring ever more value to our clients through new features and to open up new markets, beyond our historic industries such as hospitality, retail and health.

 
Context

In a context of strong growth, Skello's Growth team aims to hyper-scale lead generation and B2B customer acquisition. As a GTM Engineer (Acquisition & Growth focus), you will be the technical mastermind behind our growth engine. Your mission is to build, scale, and optimize the technical infrastructure that drives pipeline growth, automates lead generation, and maximizes our conversion rates.

You will bridge the gap between engineering, data, and growth marketing, turning aggressive acquisition strategies into robust, automated technical solutions that lower CAC and boost lead velocity. 

Missions

As a GTM Engineer specialized in Acquisition, your objectives are as follows:

  • Engine and automate lead generation pipelines: Build and maintain automated data scrapers, workflows, and API integrations with data enrichment tools to feed our CRM with highly qualified B2B leads at scale.

  • Optimize tracking & attribution infrastructure: Implement and manage advanced tracking architectures (such as server-side GTM, Segment, or custom APIs) to ensure flawless data collection across our ads channels (Google, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn) and solve complex multi-touch attribution challenges.

  • Scale GEO & SEO conversion: Develop and orchestrate scalable frameworks for landing pages, dynamic content personalization, and interactive web tools designed to turn mentions and traffic into active marketing qualified leads.

  • Deploy technical conversion optimization (CRO): Partner with Growth Marketers and Designers to engineer advanced, glitch-free A/B testing scenarios and server-side experiments to continuously push conversion rates to their maximum.

  • Build smart routing and lead scoring loops: Design and deploy automated routing and real-time lead scoring algorithms using intent data, ensuring the hottest acquisition leads are pushed instantly to the Sales team.

 

What this position can offer you:

  • The opportunity to play a highly strategic role by building the technical backbone of Skello's revenue engine;

  • The opportunity to contribute in a concrete way to an ambitious project that will revolutionize a very large market through technical innovation;

  • Ownership and autonomy over a modern tech stack (Data, CRM, APIs, AI) that will allow you to learn a lot and build scalable systems you can be proud of;

  • A stimulating, challenging, and caring work environment at the exact intersection of Engineering and Business.

Qualifications
 

Soft skills 

  • Growth & Impact obsessed: You don't just write code; you care about the pipeline generated, the conversion rates, and the ROI of your technical assets.

  • Doer & Hacker mindset: You move fast, love solving complex tracking puzzles, and prefer shipping robust automated acquisition loops over doing manual, repetitive tasks.

  • Strong Communicator: You easily align with both highly technical data engineers and performance marketers, translating acquisition goals into technical blueprints.

Hard skills

  • Web Performance Optimization: Strong understanding of Core Web Vitals, front-end optimization, and headless CMS capabilities to guarantee blazing-fast, high-converting landing pages.

  • Growth Tech Stack Mastery: Deep technical knowledge of web tracking (Server-side GTM, Pixels, CAPI), CDPs (Segment), CRMs (HubSpot/Salesforce), and Reverse ETL tools.

  • AI-Assisted Development: Advanced use of AI coding tools (Codex, Claude Code) and automation platforms (Make, n8n) to build and deploy growth hacks and POCs at lightning speed.

Nice to have

  • Past experience working closely with Performance Marketing / Paid Ads teams in a hyper-growth B2B SaaS environment.

  • Deep knowledge of Google Ads/Meta Ads/LinkedIn Ads API integrations.

Recruitment process

  • Discovery call with the Talent team

  • Technical Case Study & Business Interview with Eliott, VP Marketing

  • 3rd "Vision" interview with Quitterie, CEO of Skello

  • Reference taking and offer
